run_single_point_orca: run a single-point energy calculation using ORCA with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization using ORCA with configurable optimizer parameters and step counter
run_nbo_analysis_orca: run an ORCA single-point calculation with NBO analysis enabled for natural bond orbital analysis
run_metal_organic_orca: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS
run_parallel_orca_calculation: run an ORCA calculation parallelized across multiple CPU processes with configurable nprocs
